reason: C-3: Enforces strict 25-route allowlist on renderer extension bridge and explicitly excludes /hooks/test-run, /hooks/file/write, /settings/set, and /delete.

rust_behavior: is_extension_route_allowed returns false for dangerous execution/write routes.

reason: H-5: Rejects SVG payloads containing event handlers (onload=, onerror=), script/foreignObject tags, javascript:/data: URLs, or trailing markup after </svg>.
original_behavior: Checked only /^\s*<svg[\s>]/i prefix before interpolating directly into innerHTML.
rust_behavior: sanitize_svg_icon returns None unless strict sanitized SVG constraint holds.

reason: H-5: Restricts external links (e.g. homepage href) strictly to http:// and https:// schemes.
original_behavior: Untrusted homepage strings could inject javascript: URLs into fallback views.
rust_behavior: sanitize_external_http_url returns None for non-HTTP(S) schemes.

reason: H-5: Prevents raw icon/label/id HTML/selector injection.
original_behavior: Direct string interpolation into innerHTML and querySelector strings.
